thread:
Ravi (Billing): Hi team — HarborPay (acct HP-77) disputed invoice 94001. They were charged metered overage at full rate; a promotional overage cap (PROMO-APR-OVR) should have limited charges to $5k but they were billed $11.2k. Ticket attached.

billing-bot: Audit result: invoice=94001 promo_cap_missing. Promo flag present on customer record but not applied for overage buckets due to missing mapping in billing engine. Suggest credit $6,200 or reissue invoice with corrected cap.

Sophie (CS): Customer says they expected the cap because it was in the signed addendum. They want credit, not reissue.

Helen (Finance Lead): I'm okay with a goodwill credit since it's clearly our config mistake and under $10k normally, but this one is $6.2k over; approve as one-time exception. Please include memo text and contract reference.

Marco (Pricing): We pushed a fix to the mapping. Will run backfill so future invoices include caps. Adding a check in the promo-mapper pipeline.

Lena (Legal): No issue with credit. Add short note: "Credit issued due to internal billing mapping error; customer addendum PROMO-APR-OVR." Also save customer acceptance email.

Ravi (Billing): Processing manual credit: `/adjust-invoice 94001 credit 6200 "Promo cap credit - HarborPay PROMO-APR-OVR"` Journal BN-2026-121 created. Invoice marked adjusted. Notifying CS to confirm customer acceptance.

Sophie (CS): Customer replied: "Thanks, confirmed." Closing dispute. Will monitor next cycle to ensure cap applies. :white_check_mark:
